en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a Dutch Renaissance-style civic building on a town square. The large brick building has ornate gables, many shuttered windows, and an external staircase leading up to a main entrance. Surrounding it are narrow townhouses typical of historic Dutch city centers. Printed captions at the top identify the scene as Nijmegen and the Grote Markt. A small publisher's credit appears at the bottom.
